pages.text: The $(place)Phantom Moors$() are a grey overworld biome, found inland where it is cool. Willow spawns there.$(br2)Ruins are scattered across the Moors, each with $(num)one or two$() chests.

pages.title: In the Chests
pages.text: Bones and scraps, with a good chance of shards, meteorite scrap, JoJo Coins, Ancient Arrowheads, meteorite ingots and $(item)Totem Keys$().

About $(num)one chest in four$() holds something rarer as well: an enchanted book, a golden apple or diamonds, or perhaps$(li)the $(item)Ancient Bow$()$(li)a $(item)Meteorite Tablet$()$(li)$(item)Pluck$()$(li)a $(item)Soul Chip$()$(li)$(item)Bubble Gloves$()$(li)$(item)Lisa Lisa's Scarf$()
